tables.name: tax.registrations
tables.fact_owner: Tenant GST registration and effective place-of-business identity

checks.name: registrations_dates_ck
checks.expression: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

cross_row_invariants.name: registrations_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Reject overlapping active effective periods for the same GSTIN and prevent identity changes after referenced postings. Branch applicability is owned only by effective tax.registration_branches associations.

tables.name: tax.registration_branches
tables.fact_owner: Effective association of one GST registration with one operating branch/place of business

cross_row_invariants.name: registration_branches_effective_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: The registration and branch belong to the same organization and state; active effective periods cannot overlap for a branch, and a branch association referenced by a posted tax document is immutable. Posting and provider commands resolve registration authority only through the association covering the document date.

indexes.name: registration_branches_registration_idx
indexes.purpose: all effective places for one GSTIN

tables.name: tax.tax_code_versions
tables.fact_owner: Versioned statutory HSN/SAC tax treatment

checks.name: tax_code_versions_dates_ck
checks.expression: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

checks.name: tax_code_versions_rates_ck
checks.expression: cgst_rate >= 0 AND sgst_rate >= 0 AND igst_rate >= 0 AND cess_rate >= 0 AND cgst_rate + sgst_rate = igst_rate

cross_row_invariants.name: tax_code_versions_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Reject overlapping effective periods for the same code and require ruleset_version to identify an immutable deployed ruleset. Runtime roles are SELECT-only.

cross_row_invariants.name: tax_code_versions_release_authority
cross_row_invariants.rule: Tax-code versions are inserted only as the exact rows of a verified hsn_sac_tax release. Classification, rates, effective dates and release provenance are immutable; atomic release supersession may only retire the prior active row set. Runtime and MCP roles cannot import or select a ruleset.

tables.name: tax.documents
tables.fact_owner: Immutable GST header snapshot for exactly one posted typed business source

checks.name: documents_class_source_ck
checks.expression: (document_class = 'sales_invoice' AND sales_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) OR (document_class = 'supplier_invoice' AND supplier_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) OR (document_class = 'adjustment_note' AND adjustment_note_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: documents_zero_rated_ck
checks.expression: zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('not_applicable','without_payment','with_igst') AND ((supply_type IN ('export','sez') AND zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('without_payment','with_igst')) OR (supply_type NOT IN ('export','sez') AND zero_rated_payment_mode = 'not_applicable'))

checks.name: documents_charge_mechanism_ck
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND tax_liability_party IN ('supplier','recipient') AND ((tax_charge_mechanism = 'normal' AND tax_liability_party = 'supplier') OR (tax_charge_mechanism = 'reverse_charge' AND tax_liability_party = 'recipient'))

checks.name: documents_effect_ck
checks.expression: (document_effect = 'original' AND adjusts_tax_document_id IS NULL) OR (document_effect IN ('increase','decrease') AND adjusts_tax_document_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: documents_components_ck
checks.expression: net_value_amount >= 0 AND gst_taxable_value >= 0 AND gst_taxable_value <= net_value_amount AND cgst_amount >= 0 AND sgst_amount >= 0 AND igst_amount >= 0 AND cess_amount >= 0 AND self_assessed_tax_amount >= 0 AND counterparty_payable_amount >= 0

checks.name: documents_payable_ck
checks.expression: ((tax_charge_mechanism = 'normal' AND self_assessed_tax_amount = 0 AND counterparty_payable_amount = net_value_amount + cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount + rounding_adjustment) OR (tax_charge_mechanism = 'reverse_charge' AND counterparty_payable_amount = net_value_amount + rounding_adjustment AND ((direction = 'inward' AND self_assessed_tax_amount = cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount) OR (direction = 'outward' AND self_assessed_tax_amount = 0))))

checks.name: documents_component_mode_ck
checks.expression: (supply_type = 'intra_state' AND igst_amount = 0 AND cgst_amount = sgst_amount) OR (supply_type <> 'intra_state' AND cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0)

checks.name: documents_zero_rated_components_ck
checks.expression: supply_type NOT IN ('export','sez') OR ((zero_rated_payment_mode = 'without_payment' AND cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount = 0 AND cess_amount = 0) OR (zero_rated_payment_mode = 'with_igst' AND cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount > 0 AND cess_amount = 0))

indexes.name: documents_sales_source_uq
indexes.purpose: one tax snapshot per sales invoice

indexes.name: documents_supplier_source_uq
indexes.purpose: one tax snapshot per supplier invoice

indexes.name: documents_adjustment_source_uq
indexes.purpose: one tax snapshot per adjustment note

indexes.name: documents_adjustment_idx
indexes.purpose: signed tax adjustment lineage and cumulative reversal ceiling

cross_row_invariants.name: documents_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Insert only with the typed source posted and locked; copy exact rounded net_value_amount, gst_taxable_value, recipient-assessed components, rounding adjustment and counterparty payable from immutable business-line snapshots. Derive organization self_assessed_tax_amount from direction: it equals recipient-assessed components only for inward reverse charge and is zero for outward reverse charge. Validate registration, place of supply, zero-rated payment mode, tax-liability party and ruleset. An adjustment locks its original tax document, copies its tax context, records increase/decrease explicitly, and cumulative decreases by each rounded component and value cannot exceed the original plus prior increases. Block UPDATE and DELETE.

tables.name: tax.withholdings
tables.fact_owner: Typed statutory tax deduction or compensating reversal against one payable open item

checks.name: withholdings_regime_ck
checks.expression: (tax_regime = 'income_tax_tds' AND registration_id IS NULL AND gst_component_mode = 'not_applicable' AND withholding_rate = income_tax_rate AND income_tax_rate > 0 AND cgst_rate = 0 AND sgst_rate = 0 AND igst_rate = 0 AND income_tax_amount = round(basis_amount * income_tax_rate / 100,2) AND income_tax_amount = withheld_amount AND cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount = 0) OR (tax_regime = 'gst_tds' AND registration_id IS NOT NULL AND gst_component_mode IN ('intra_state','inter_state') AND income_tax_rate = 0 AND income_tax_amount = 0 AND ((gst_component_mode = 'intra_state' AND withholding_rate = cgst_rate + sgst_rate AND cgst_rate = sgst_rate AND cgst_rate > 0 AND igst_rate = 0 AND cgst_amount = round(basis_amount * cgst_rate / 100,2) AND sgst_amount = round(basis_amount * sgst_rate / 100,2) AND cgst_amount = sgst_amount AND igst_amount = 0) OR (gst_component_mode = 'inter_state' AND withholding_rate = igst_rate AND cgst_rate = 0 AND sgst_rate = 0 AND igst_rate > 0 AND cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount = round(basis_amount * igst_rate / 100,2))))

checks.name: withholdings_trigger_ck
checks.expression: (deduction_trigger = 'credit' AND triggered_by_payment_id IS NULL) OR (deduction_trigger = 'payment' AND triggered_by_payment_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: withholdings_amount_ck
checks.expression: currency_code = 'INR' AND basis_amount > 0 AND withholding_rate > 0 AND withheld_amount > 0 AND withheld_amount = income_tax_amount + cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount

checks.name: withholdings_identifier_ck
checks.expression: ((tax_regime = 'income_tax_tds' AND deductor_tax_identifier ~ '^[A-Z]{4}[0-9]{5}[A-Z]$') OR (tax_regime = 'gst_tds' AND deductor_tax_identifier ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$')) AND ((deductee_identifier_kind = 'unavailable' AND deductee_tax_identifier IS NULL) OR (deductee_identifier_kind = 'pan' AND deductee_tax_identifier ~ '^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$') OR (deductee_identifier_kind = 'gstin' AND deductee_tax_identifier ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$'))

checks.name: withholdings_reversal_ck
checks.expression: (reversal_of_withholding_id IS NULL AND reversal_reason IS NULL) OR (reversal_of_withholding_id IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL AND status = 'reversed')

cross_row_invariants.name: withholdings_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Lock the payable open item and optional posted payment. Apply the immutable ruleset selected by deduction_date: the earlier credit/payment event selects the governing Income-tax Act and provision; GST TDS requires a tax_deductor registration and its basis excludes invoice GST and cess. Require counterparty and currency to match, cap active withholding allocations by both the withholding and open-item principal, create exactly one accounting event, and freeze statutory amounts. Deposit, statement and certificate evidence belong only to their typed many-to-many aggregates. A reversal copies every financial and law snapshot, posts a compensating journal and allocation reversal, and never deletes or rewrites deduction evidence.

tables.name: tax.withholding_deposits
tables.fact_owner: One immutable statutory challan backed by one exact posted government disbursement

checks.name: withholding_deposits_regime_ck
checks.expression: (tax_regime='income_tax_tds' AND registration_id IS NULL) OR (tax_regime='gst_tds' AND registration_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: withholding_deposits_reversal_ck
checks.expression: (status='posted' AND reversal_of_deposit_id IS NULL AND reversal_reason IS NULL) OR (status='reversed' AND reversal_of_deposit_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(reversal_reason)<>'')

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_deposits_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting locks an INR government disbursement in posted state, verified retained challan evidence, and all included deductions. Line component sums must equal both deposited_amount and the exact payment amount. A compensating reversal links the reversed payment, copies the statutory snapshot, and never edits the original challan or lines.

tables.name: tax.withholding_deposit_lines
tables.fact_owner: Immutable M:N allocation of one challan to exact withholding deductions

checks.name: withholding_deposit_lines_amount_ck
checks.expression: income_tax_amount>=0 AND cgst_amount>=0 AND sgst_amount>=0 AND igst_amount>=0 AND deposited_amount>0 AND deposited_amount=income_tax_amount+cgst_amount+sgst_amount+igst_amount

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_deposit_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the deposit command inserts lines while locking the deposit and deduction. Tax regime, registration and exact components must match; cumulative active deposits cannot exceed the deduction components. Rows are immutable and reversal uses a linked compensating deposit.

tables.name: tax.withholding_statements
tables.fact_owner: Immutable statutory withholding statement revision and authority acknowledgement

checks.name: withholding_statements_regime_ck
checks.expression: (tax_regime='income_tax_tds' AND registration_id IS NULL) OR (tax_regime='gst_tds' AND registration_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: withholding_statements_period_ck
checks.expression: fiscal_year_start_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999 AND period_start>=make_date(fiscal_year_start_year,4,1) AND period_end<=make_date(fiscal_year_start_year+1,3,31) AND period_end>=period_start

indexes.name: withholding_statements_revision_uq
indexes.purpose: single next revision of a statement

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_statements_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: The filing command locks one exact statement population of deductions and deposit lines, verifies retained authority acknowledgement evidence, and inserts a complete immutable revision. A revision copies the filing context and links one prior statement; the current head is derived by absence of a child revision. Statements and lines are never updated or deleted.

tables.name: tax.withholding_statement_lines
tables.fact_owner: Immutable M:N filed-statement membership and per-deductee certificate evidence

indexes.name: withholding_statement_lines_deposit_uq
indexes.purpose: one deposit allocation per statement revision

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_statement_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the statement command inserts lines. Each deposit line must belong to the same withholding and regime, be active and fully cover the reported deduction; the deduction date must lie in the statement period. Lines are immutable and corrections use a new statement revision.

tables.name: tax.withholding_certificates
tables.fact_owner: Immutable per-deductee statutory certificate authority artifact

checks.name: withholding_certificates_regime_ck
checks.expression: (tax_regime='income_tax_tds' AND registration_id IS NULL) OR (tax_regime='gst_tds' AND registration_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: withholding_certificates_period_ck
checks.expression: fiscal_year_start_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999 AND period_start>=make_date(fiscal_year_start_year,4,1) AND period_end<=make_date(fiscal_year_start_year+1,3,31) AND period_end>=period_start AND issued_on>=period_end

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_certificates_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the certificate import command inserts a verified retained authority artifact. It locks one deductee, regime and period, freezes the typed form/reference/evidence, and links every covered filed statement line. Corrections append a child and never update or delete prior certificates.

tables.name: tax.withholding_certificate_lines
tables.fact_owner: Immutable M:N certificate coverage of filed withholding statement lines

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_certificate_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: The certificate command proves the statement line belongs to the same withholding, deductee, regime and period, and copies the exact filed deduction amount. Lines are immutable; corrected certificates use new linked rows without overwriting prior evidence.

tables.name: tax.return_periods
tables.fact_owner: GST filing period and lock state for one registration

checks.name: return_periods_lock_ck
checks.expression: status = 'open' OR (locked_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: return_periods_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Reject overlapping periods for a registration; a filed return atomically moves the period to filed and prevents membership changes.

tables.name: tax.returns
tables.fact_owner: Versioned GST return filing, validation, and authority acknowledgement

checks.name: returns_revision_ck
checks.expression: revision > 0 AND ((revision = 1 AND previous_return_id IS NULL) OR (revision > 1 AND previous_return_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: returns_totals_ck
checks.expression: taxable_amount >= 0 AND cgst_amount >= 0 AND sgst_amount >= 0 AND igst_amount >= 0 AND cess_amount >= 0 AND liability_amount >= 0

checks.name: returns_payload_ck
checks.expression: (payload_attachment_id IS NULL AND payload_sha256 IS NULL) OR (payload_attachment_id IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(payload_sha256) = 32)

checks.name: returns_filed_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'filed' OR (arn IS NOT NULL AND filed_at IS NOT NULL AND filed_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND payload_attachment_id IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: returns_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Validation recomputes totals from return_documents; filing verifies the exact payload hash, freezes return and membership rows, marks prior filed revision superseded, and disallows UPDATE/DELETE thereafter.

tables.name: tax.return_documents
tables.fact_owner: Explicit M:N membership of an internal tax document in a return revision

cross_row_invariants.name: return_documents_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Allow INSERT/DELETE only while return is draft; validate registration, period, direction and return-type eligibility; filed membership is immutable.

tables.name: tax.portal_documents
tables.fact_owner: Immutable GST portal source file with bounded parsing lifecycle

checks.name: portal_documents_parse_ck
checks.expression: (status = 'parsed' AND parsed_at IS NOT NULL AND parse_error_code IS NULL) OR (status = 'rejected' AND parse_error_code IS NOT NULL) OR status IN ('imported','superseded')

cross_row_invariants.name: portal_documents_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Verify attachment hash before parsing; insert all lines atomically; source identity, bytes, and parsed lines are immutable after parsed.

tables.name: tax.portal_document_lines
tables.fact_owner: Normalized immutable invoice line from one GST portal document

checks.name: portal_document_lines_amount_ck
checks.expression: taxable_amount >= 0 AND cgst_amount >= 0 AND sgst_amount >= 0 AND igst_amount >= 0 AND cess_amount >= 0 AND total_amount = taxable_amount + cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount

cross_row_invariants.name: portal_document_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Insert only in the parent parse transaction, reject duplicate source-row hashes within a portal document, then block UPDATE and DELETE.

tables.name: tax.reconciliation_runs
tables.fact_owner: Versioned execution boundary for GST internal-to-portal reconciliation

checks.name: reconciliation_runs_terminal_ck
checks.expression: (status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND failure_code IS NULL) OR (status = 'failed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND failure_code IS NOT NULL) OR status IN ('running','superseded')

cross_row_invariants.name: reconciliation_runs_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Take a repeatable-read snapshot of internal and portal populations; atomically insert all items and terminal status; only one running run per registration/period/portal document.

tables.name: tax.reconciliation_items
tables.fact_owner: Auditable match result between one internal tax document and/or one portal line

checks.name: reconciliation_items_match_ck
checks.expression: (match_status IN ('matched','mismatch') AND tax_document_id IS NOT NULL AND portal_document_line_id IS NOT NULL) OR (match_status = 'internal_only' AND tax_document_id IS NOT NULL AND portal_document_line_id IS NULL) OR (match_status = 'portal_only' AND tax_document_id IS NULL AND portal_document_line_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: reconciliation_items_confidence_ck
checks.expression: confidence_score IS NULL OR confidence_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1

checks.name: reconciliation_items_resolution_ck
checks.expression: resolution_status IN ('unresolved','accepted','corrected','ignored') AND (resolution_status = 'unresolved') = (resolved_at IS NULL AND resolved_by_membership_id IS NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: reconciliation_items_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Populate only while run is running; match evidence and differences are immutable. Resolution may transition once from unresolved by an authorized actor and is audit-logged.

tables.name: tax.eway_bills
tables.fact_owner: Append-only e-way bill authority artifact version for one posted physical inventory movement with an optional matching tax document

checks.name: eway_bills_version_ck
checks.expression: artifact_version > 0 AND ((artifact_version = 1 AND supersedes_artifact_id IS NULL) OR (artifact_version > 1 AND supersedes_artifact_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: eway_bills_response_ck
checks.expression: (response_bytes IS NULL AND response_media_type IS NULL AND response_sha256 IS NULL) OR (response_bytes IS NOT NULL AND response_media_type IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(response_sha256) = 32)

checks.name: eway_bills_generated_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('generated','cancelled','expired') OR (eway_bill_number IS NOT NULL AND valid_from_at IS NOT NULL AND valid_until_at > valid_from_at)

checks.name: eway_bills_cancel_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'cancelled' OR (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: eway_bills_tax_document_version_uq
indexes.purpose: one artifact version per tax-document evidence chain

indexes.name: eway_bills_inventory_document_version_uq
indexes.purpose: one artifact version per inventory-movement evidence chain

indexes.name: eway_bills_successor_uq
indexes.purpose: one immutable successor per authority artifact

cross_row_invariants.name: eway_bills_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Provider transitions append or complete immutable envelope evidence under idempotency for one mandatory posted physical inventory movement and, when present, its matching tax document; cancellation never overwrites authority response. Regeneration requires a new version linked through supersedes_artifact_id.

tables.name: tax.einvoices
tables.fact_owner: Append-only IRN and signed e-invoice authority artifact version

checks.name: einvoices_version_ck
checks.expression: artifact_version > 0 AND ((artifact_version = 1 AND supersedes_artifact_id IS NULL) OR (artifact_version > 1 AND supersedes_artifact_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: einvoices_response_ck
checks.expression: (response_bytes IS NULL AND response_media_type IS NULL AND response_sha256 IS NULL) OR (response_bytes IS NOT NULL AND response_media_type IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(response_sha256) = 32)

checks.name: einvoices_qr_ck
checks.expression: (signed_qr_bytes IS NULL AND signed_qr_sha256 IS NULL) OR (signed_qr_bytes IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(signed_qr_sha256) = 32)

checks.name: einvoices_generated_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('generated','cancelled') OR (irn IS NOT NULL AND acknowledgement_number IS NOT NULL AND acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL AND signed_qr_bytes IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: einvoices_cancel_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'cancelled' OR (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: einvoices_irn_uq
indexes.where: status = 'generated' AND irn IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: einvoices_successor_uq
indexes.purpose: one immutable successor per authority artifact

cross_row_invariants.name: einvoices_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Provider transitions append/complete immutable request, response and signed-QR evidence under idempotency. Cancellation and regeneration create new authority evidence; no artifact row is deleted or repointed.

tables.name: tax.withholding_rule_versions
tables.fact_owner: Migration-owned effective-dated Income-tax and GST-TDS rule authority

checks.name: withholding_rule_versions_dates_ck
checks.expression: fiscal_year_start_from BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999 AND (fiscal_year_start_to IS NULL OR fiscal_year_start_to>=fiscal_year_start_from) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>=effective_from)

checks.name: withholding_rule_versions_applicability_ck
checks.expression: deductor_person_type IN ('any','individual','huf','company','firm','llp','trust','aop','boi','government','local_authority','artificial_juridical_person','other') AND deductee_person_type IN ('any','individual','huf','company','firm','llp','trust','aop','boi','government','local_authority','artificial_juridical_person','other') AND deductee_residency IN ('any','resident','non_resident') AND deductee_pan_status IN ('any','verified','inoperative','not_available','not_applicable')

checks.name: withholding_rule_versions_threshold_ck
checks.expression: (organization_prior_fy_turnover_threshold IS NULL OR organization_prior_fy_turnover_threshold>=0) AND transaction_threshold>=0 AND aggregation_scope IN ('party_rule_fiscal_year','contract') AND threshold_application IN ('excess_only','full_amount')

checks.name: withholding_rule_versions_rates_ck
checks.expression: income_tax_rate>=0 AND cgst_rate>=0 AND sgst_rate>=0 AND igst_rate>=0 AND ((tax_regime='income_tax_tds' AND income_tax_rate>0 AND cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND igst_rate=0) OR (tax_regime='gst_tds' AND income_tax_rate=0 AND ((cgst_rate>0 AND sgst_rate=cgst_rate AND igst_rate=0) OR (cgst_rate=0 AND sgst_rate=0 AND igst_rate>0))))

checks.name: withholding_rule_versions_due_ck
checks.expression: deposit_due_policy IN ('day_of_following_month','days_after_deduction','fixed_date_after_fy_end') AND deposit_month_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 24 AND deposit_due_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_rule_versions_release_authority
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the isolated regulatory importer inserts the exact canonical row set of a verified withholding_rules release. Rule identity, applicability, thresholds, aggregation, rates and deposit policy are immutable; active effective periods for the same rule and applicability dimensions cannot overlap, and release supersession retires the prior row set atomically.

tables.name: tax.organization_fiscal_tax_facts
tables.fact_owner: Verified tenant Indian-fiscal-year tax applicability, identifier and turnover evidence

cross_row_invariants.name: organization_fiscal_tax_facts_evidence_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: fiscal_year_start_year means the Indian fiscal year beginning 1 April of that year. Activation requires verified immutable attachment evidence and a distinct authorized verifier; one active fact exists per organization and fiscal year, and supersession never rewrites prior turnover, TAN, notified-deductor or e-invoice exemption evidence.

tables.name: tax.withholding_basis_lines
tables.fact_owner: Immutable exact source-line basis and threshold aggregation membership for one withholding

checks.name: withholding_basis_lines_fy_ck
checks.expression: fiscal_year_start_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999 AND source_event_date BETWEEN make_date(fiscal_year_start_year,4,1) AND make_date(fiscal_year_start_year+1,3,31)

checks.name: withholding_basis_lines_text_ck
checks.expression: btrim(nature_code)<>'' AND (contract_reference IS NULL OR btrim(contract_reference)<>'')

checks.name: withholding_basis_lines_amount_ck
checks.expression: source_gross_amount>0 AND excluded_gst_cess_amount>=0 AND prior_advance_basis_amount>=0 AND eligible_basis_amount>0 AND eligible_basis_amount=source_gross_amount-excluded_gst_cess_amount-prior_advance_basis_amount

indexes.name: withholding_basis_lines_advance_idx
indexes.purpose: one statutory basis membership per exact vendor advance allocation

cross_row_invariants.name: withholding_basis_lines_source_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the withholding deduction command or its private zero-deduction evaluator inserts rows. It locks the posted supplier invoice line, posted expense claim line, or exact posted pharma-goods purchase-order advance allocation; copies exact party, nature, contract, earlier-event date and eligible amount under the selected immutable rule; and computes cumulative party/rule/fiscal-year or contract thresholds under lock. Below-threshold classified sources persist immutable basis with nullable withholding_id so later transactions cannot reset cumulative eligibility. A later supplier invoice excludes an already-observed advance basis and reclassifies the supplier-prepayment receivable without duplicate withholding. Rows cannot be updated or deleted; reversed advance lineage is excluded without changing basis history.

tables.name: tax.einvoice_rule_versions
tables.fact_owner: One effective reviewed e-invoice applicability and reporting-window rule for a document and registration context

cross_row_invariants.name: einvoice_rule_versions_release_authority
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the isolated regulatory importer inserts the exact canonical row set of a verified einvoice_rules release. PAN prior-fiscal-year threshold, organization/person exemption, registration/document/supply scope and reporting window are immutable; active effective periods for one applicability dimension cannot overlap and release supersession retires the prior set atomically.

checks.name: einvoice_rule_versions_threshold_ck
checks.expression: minimum_prior_fy_turnover>=0 AND (reporting_window_days IS NULL OR reporting_window_days>0)

tables.name: tax.gst_adjustment_rule_versions
tables.fact_owner: One effective reviewed GST statutory-adjustment eligibility and evidence rule

cross_row_invariants.name: gst_adjustment_rule_versions_release_authority
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the isolated regulatory importer inserts the exact canonical row set of a verified gst_adjustment_rules release. Side, direction, reason, deadline policy, portal-evidence requirement and tax effect are immutable; active effective periods for one applicability dimension cannot overlap and release supersession retires the prior set atomically.

checks.name: gst_adjustment_rule_versions_shape_ck
checks.expression: side IN ('sales','purchase') AND direction IN ('credit','debit') AND document_effect IN ('increase','decrease') AND btrim(reason_code)<>''

checks.name: gst_adjustment_rule_versions_deadline_ck
checks.expression: deadline_policy IN ('none','days_after_original','november_30_following_fy') AND ((deadline_policy='days_after_original' AND deadline_days>0) OR (deadline_policy<>'days_after_original' AND deadline_days IS NULL))

checks.name: gst_adjustment_rule_versions_effect_ck
checks.expression: tax_effect IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND (side='purchase' OR NOT portal_evidence_required)
